req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a GET request to /cookies/set/<name>/<value> should set a cookie and redirect to /cookies. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle invalid input, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_positive
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
expected: The Set-Cookie header is present with name 'testcookie' and value 'testvalue'.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set/testcookie/testvalue')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Set-Cookie'].startswith('testcookie=testvalue')
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'

tests.name: test_set_cookie_negative
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies/set/ with missing name and value.
expected: The response status code is 404, indicating a client error due to malformed URL.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set/')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_set_cookie_boundary
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies/set/ with maximum length name and value.
expected: The Set-Cookie header is present with the maximum length name and value.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
max_length_name = 'a' * 256
max_length_value = 'b' * 256
response = client.get(f'/cookies/set/{max_length_name}/{max_length_value}')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Set-Cookie'].startswith(f'{max_length_name}={max_length_value}')
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'
